scope: One fixed HistGradientBoostingClassifier uses eight completed 100ms Bybit BTCUSDT top-five L2 and flow features to estimate whether a 40bp absolute executable-mid first passage is imminent. One 99th-percentile score creates a local monitoring state, not an exchange order. Same-timestamp two-sided crossings are rejected. Three structural target/stop cells, one global slot and identical 12/18/24bp paths are fixed. No elapsed-time liquidation, risk search, leverage search, credentials or orders.
decision: Retire the exact completed-100ms top-five L2 absolute-hazard local-trigger dependency. Do not tune its model, features, threshold, entry offset, target, stop, latency, risk or leverage.
